name: Prawn Cocktail Salad

ingredients.display: 2 handfuls little gem or mixed salad leaves, shredded

steps: Stir the mayonnaise, yoghurt, tomato puree and lemon juice together with a pinch of black pepper.
Fold the prawns through the dressing.
Pile the leaves, cucumber and tomatoes into a bowl or lidded box and spoon the prawns on top.
Serve with the bread alongside.

name: Chicken And Noodle Soup

ingredients.display: 1 chicken stock cube, made up with 500 ml water

steps: Bring the stock to a simmer with the ginger and garlic.
Add the chicken breast whole and poach gently for 12 minutes, then lift out and shred.
Add the carrot, leek and noodles to the stock and simmer for 5 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken, season with soy sauce and scatter with spring onion.

name: Smoked Salmon And Cream Cheese Bagel
steps: Spread both bagel halves with the cream cheese and grind over black pepper.
Layer on the cucumber, rocket and smoked salmon.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and close the bagel.

name: Tuna Jacket Potato

ingredients.display: 1 large tin tuna in spring water, drained

steps: Prick the potato and bake at 200C for 50-60 minutes until the skin is crisp.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, sweetcorn and spring onion, and season.
Split the potato open and fill with the tuna mixture.

name: Greek-Style Butter Bean Salad

ingredients.display: 180 g tinned butter beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Whisk the yoghurt with the lemon juice, oregano and black pepper to make a dressing.
Combine the butter beans, cucumber, tomato and red onion in a bowl.
Spoon over the dressing and top with the feta.

name: Cottage Cheese And Chickpea Bowl
steps: Toss the chickpeas with the lemon juice, paprika and black pepper.
Layer the rocket, cucumber and tomatoes into a bowl or lunch box.
Add the cottage cheese and dressed chickpeas, then scatter with seeds.

name: Spiced Red Lentil Soup With Yoghurt

ingredients.display: 1 vegetable stock cube, made up with 500 ml water
1 tsp ground cumin and 1/2 tsp turmeric

steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in a splash of water for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices, then add the lentils and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse, then blend or mash to a rough puree.
Finish with lemon juice and swirl the yoghurt through before serving.

name: Chicken Caesar-Style Salad

ingredients.display: 1 small slice sourdough, torn into croutons

steps: Toss the bread with the oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp.
Season the chicken and griddle for 6 minutes each side until cooked through, then slice.
Beat the yoghurt, mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice and half the parmesan into a dressing.
Coat the leaves in the dressing, add the chicken and croutons and finish with the rest of the parmesan.

name: Thai-Style Turkey Larb Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet and set aside.
Fry the turkey mince in the sesame oil over high heat for 6-8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through.
Take off the heat and stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, chilli and spring onion.
Serve over the rice with the cucumber and carrot alongside.

name: Smoked Mackerel Pate On Sourdough
steps: Flake the mackerel into a bowl, removing any bones.
Mash with the quark, lemon juice and pepper until spreadable but still textured.
Toast the sourdough, spread with the pate and top with rocket.

name: Sesame Tofu And Edamame Noodle Salad
steps: Cook the noodles and edamame together for 4 minutes, then drain and cool under the tap.
Pan-fry the tofu in the sesame oil until golden on all sides.
Whisk the soy sauce and vinegar together.
Toss the noodles, edamame, cucumber, carrot and spring onion in the dressing, top with tofu and sesame seeds.

name: Pea, Potato And Spinach Frittata

ingredients.display: 90 g new potatoes, cooked and sliced

steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and slice.
Heat the oil in a small non-stick pan and wilt the spinach with the peas for 2 minutes, then add the potatoes.
Beat the eggs and egg whites with black pepper, pour into the pan and scatter over the feta.
Cook on a low heat for 8 minutes, then finish under a hot grill until set. Cool and slice; eat warm or cold.

name: Lentil, Feta And Tomato Salad
steps: Tip the lentils into a bowl and dress with the oil, lemon juice and black pepper.
Stir through the tomatoes, cucumber and red onion.
Serve on the salad leaves with the feta crumbled over.

name: Tuna And Sweetcorn Pasta Salad

ingredients.display: 1 large tin tuna in spring water, drained

steps: Boil the pasta until al dente, then drain and cool under cold water.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, lemon juice and black pepper.
Fold the pasta, sweetcorn, tomatoes and spring onion through the tuna and chill until needed.

name: Prawn And Egg Fried Rice

ingredients.display: 60 g dried basmati rice, cooked and cooled

steps: Heat the sesame oil in a wok and fry the carrot and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and peas and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes.
Push the rice aside, pour in the egg and scramble briefly, then mix through.
Add the prawns and soy sauce, heat for 2 minutes and finish with spring onion.

name: Spanish-Style Potato Omelette
steps: Boil the potato slices for 6 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Soften the onion in the oil in a small non-stick pan, add the potatoes and paprika.
Wilt in the spinach, then pour over the beaten eggs and whites.
Cook on a low heat for 8 minutes, then finish under the grill until set. Cool before slicing.

name: Chicken And Avocado Wrap
steps: Season the chicken and pan-fry for 6 minutes each side until cooked through, then slice.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice and spread over the wrap.
Add the salad leaves, chicken, salsa and cheddar.
Roll up tightly, tucking in the ends, and cut in half.

name: Quorn Chilli Rice Bowl

ingredients.display: 1 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp ground cumin

steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the spices and tomato puree.
Add the Quorn mince, chopped tomatoes, beans, crumbled stock cube and a splash of water.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then serve over the rice.

name: Black Bean And Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Mash half the black beans with the cumin, then stir in the rest with the pepper and spring onion.
Spread the mixture over one half of the wrap, scatter with cheddar and fold over.
Dry-fry in a hot pan for 2-3 minutes each side until crisp and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa and yoghurt.

name: Halloumi And Couscous Mezze Plate
steps: Pour 75 ml boiling stock over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fork through.
Dry-fry the halloumi for 1-2 minutes each side until golden.
Toss the chickpeas, pepper and cucumber with the lemon juice, oil and coriander.
Plate the couscous, spoon over the salad and lay the halloumi on top.

name: Tempeh And Mushroom Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the brown rice for 25 minutes, adding the tenderstem for the final 3 minutes.
Fry the tempeh in the sesame oil until browned on all sides.
Add the mushrooms, garlic and ginger and cook for 4 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce, toss, and serve over the rice with sesame seeds.

name: Salmon Nicoise-Style Salad
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Bake the salmon at 190C for 14 minutes, then flake into large pieces.
Whisk the oil, mustard and lemon juice, then toss with the potatoes, beans, tomatoes and leaves.
Top with the salmon and egg.

name: Jacket Potato With Baked Beans And Cheddar
steps: Prick the potato, rub with salt and bake at 200C for 55 minutes until crisp.
Heat the beans in a pan or microwave.
Split the potato, spoon over the beans and scatter with cheddar and spring onion.

name: Beef Chilli Rice Bowl

ingredients.display: 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp chilli powder

steps: Cook the rice for 25 minutes and drain.
Brown the mince in the oil, then add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices and tomato puree, then add the tomatoes, beans, stock cube and 100 ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until thick and serve over the rice. Keeps well for reheating.

name: Harissa Chicken Couscous
steps: Coat the chicken in the harissa and roast at 200C for 22 minutes with the pepper and courgette tossed in the oil.
Pour 100 ml boiling stock over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fork through the chickpeas.
Slice the chicken and pile it with the roast vegetables onto the couscous.
Finish with the yoghurt.

name: Chicken And Quinoa Protein Bowl

ingredients.display: 1/2 a head of broccoli (100 g), in florets
1 tsp smoked paprika and black pepper

steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Rub the chicken with the oil and spices and grill for 7 minutes a side until cooked through.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes and keep the pepper raw.
Mix the yoghurt with the lemon juice to make a dressing.
Slice the chicken, pile everything over the quinoa and spinach and spoon over the dressing.

name: Tuna And Cottage Cheese Jacket

ingredients.display: 1 tin (112 g drained) tuna in spring water
a good grind of black pepper

steps: Bake the potato until soft, or microwave for 10 minutes and finish in a hot oven for 10.
Flake the tuna and mix with the cottage cheese, sweetcorn, spring onion and lemon juice.
Split the potato, season with the pepper and spoon the tuna mixture in.

name: Prawn And Edamame Noodle Box

ingredients.display: 1/2 a red pepper (60 g), finely sliced

steps: Boil the noodles for 4 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 2 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil and ginger together.
Toss the noodles, edamame, prawns, pepper and spring onion in the dressing and pack into a box.

name: Egg White And Mozzarella Frittata Box

ingredients.display: 1/2 a ball (60 g) light mozzarella, torn
3 new potatoes (100 g), cooked and sliced
1/2 tsp dried oregano and black pepper

steps: Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan and wilt the spinach for 1 minute.
Add the potato slices and tomatoes and spread them out evenly.
Beat the egg white with the whole egg and the oregano, pour into the pan and cook for 4 minutes.
Scatter over the mozzarella and grill for 6 minutes until set and golden.
Cool, then cut into wedges and pack.

name: Quark, Lentil And Beetroot Salad

ingredients.display: 1/2 tsp dried dill and black pepper

steps: Beat the quark with the lemon juice, dill and pepper until smooth and spoonable.
Toss the lentils, beetroot and red onion with the balsamic vinegar.
Pile the lentils onto the rocket, add the quark and scatter with the seeds.

name: Smoked Salmon, Egg And Quark Plate

ingredients.display: 1/2 tsp dried dill and black pepper

steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool under cold water and peel.
Mix the quark with the lemon juice, dill and pepper.
Toast the sourdough.
Lay the salmon, halved eggs, cucumber and rocket on a plate and serve with the quark and toast.

name: Pastrami And Rye Slaw Box

ingredients.display: a large handful (80 g) red cabbage, finely shredded

steps: Mix the quark, mayonnaise, mustard and vinegar with black pepper.
Stir in the cabbage, carrot and radishes to make a slaw.
Pack the slaw in a lidded box with the pastrami folded on top.
Carry the rye bread separately and build open sandwiches at the table.

name: Smoked Mackerel And Beetroot Rye Plate

ingredients.display: 1 small smoked mackerel fillet (80 g), skin removed

steps: Flake the mackerel and mash it into half the quark with the lemon juice and black pepper.
Stir the capers through the pate.
Spoon the remaining quark into a pot and top with the beetroot and radishes.
Pack the pate, the beetroot pot, the rocket and the rye bread in separate sections and assemble when eating.

name: Crab And Avocado Rice Cake Plate

ingredients.display: 2 tins (160 g drained) white crab meat
a third of a cucumber (80 g), sliced
half a red chilli (5 g), finely chopped
a small handful (5 g) coriander, chopped

steps: Mix the crab with the cottage cheese, lime juice, chilli and coriander.
Mash the avocado in a separate pot with a little lime juice and black pepper.
Pack the crab mix, avocado, cucumber and tomatoes in a lidded box.
Keep the rice cakes dry in a bag and top them just before eating.

name: Chickpea Pasta Pesto And Mozzarella Salad

ingredients.display: half a light mozzarella ball (60 g), torn

steps: Cook the chickpea pasta as the pack directs, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Toss the cold pasta with the pesto and lemon juice.
Stir through the tomatoes, mozzarella and basil.
Pack with the rocket on top and mix in when eating.

name: Red Lentil Pasta Tuna And Caper Salad

ingredients.display: 1 tin (100 g drained) tuna in spring water
a quarter of a red onion (30 g), finely sliced
a small handful (8 g) parsley, chopped

steps: Cook the red lentil pasta as the pack directs, then cool it under cold water and drain.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice with black pepper.
Toss the pasta with the tuna, peppers, olives, capers, onion and parsley.
Add the dressing, mix and pack into a lidded box.

name: Falafel And Edamame Mezze Box

ingredients.display: 1 mug (120 g) frozen podded edamame, defrosted
1 small pot (100 g) plain protein yoghurt
a third of a cucumber (80 g), in sticks
a few mint leaves (4 g), chopped

steps: Stir the mint and lemon juice into the protein yoghurt to make a dip.
Defrost the edamame in cold water and drain, then season with black pepper.
Pack the falafel, hummus, edamame, cucumber and tomatoes in a divided box.
Keep the yoghurt dip in a small pot alongside.

name: Smoked Tofu And Bulgur Herb Salad

ingredients.display: a third of a cucumber (80 g), diced
a few mint leaves (5 g), chopped

steps: Cover the bulgur with boiling water, leave 10 minutes, then drain and cool.
Mix the bulgur with the cucumber, tomato, spring onion and herbs.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice and black pepper and stir.
Fold the smoked tofu through and pack in a lidded box.

name: Cottage Cheese And Radish Oatcake Plate

ingredients.display: a third of a cucumber (80 g), sliced

steps: Season the cottage cheese with black pepper, the lemon juice and the spring onion.
Pack it into a lidded pot and scatter the seeds over.
Pack the radishes, cucumber and tomatoes alongside.
Keep the oatcakes in a bag and top them at the table.

name: Tinned Salmon And Quinoa Jar

ingredients.display: a third of a cucumber (80 g), diced
a small handful (8 g) parsley, chopped

steps: Cook the quinoa, drain and cool it fully. Batch-cook it ahead if easier.
Mix the yoghurt with the lemon juice, capers, parsley and black pepper.
Layer the dressing, then the quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes and spring onion in a jar.
Flake the salmon on top, seal and shake before eating.

name: Chicken And Sugar Snap Rice Noodle Salad

ingredients.display: a large handful (80 g) sugar snap peas, halved
a quarter of a cucumber (60 g), in strips

steps: Soak the rice noodles in boiling water until soft, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, sweet chilli sauce and sesame oil.
Toss the noodles with the chicken, sugar snaps, carrot, cucumber and coriander.
Add the dressing, mix and pack cold.

name: Edamame Pea And Ricotta Barley Salad

ingredients.display: 1 large mug (140 g) frozen podded edamame
a large handful (80 g) frozen peas
a few mint leaves (5 g), chopped

steps: Cook the pearl barley until tender, then drain and cool. Cook a larger batch to reuse.
Pour boiling water over the edamame and peas, leave 2 minutes, then drain and cool.
Mix the barley, edamame and peas with the lemon juice, olive oil, mint and black pepper.
Pack with the ricotta spooned on top and the rocket alongside.

name: Goats Cheese And Lentil Pepper Jar

ingredients.display: 1 pouch (250 g) cooked puy or green lentils
45 g soft goats cheese (about 2 thick slices)

steps: Tip the lentils into a bowl and break up any clumps.
Stir in the peppers, sun dried tomatoes, basil, balsamic vinegar and black pepper.
Spoon into a jar and crumble the goats cheese over.
Pack the rocket on top and stir it in when eating.

name: Egg And Cottage Cheese Sandwich

ingredients.display: a quarter of a cucumber (50 g), sliced

steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool under cold water and peel. Boil a batch ahead if you prefer.
Chop the eggs and mix with the cottage cheese, mayonnaise, mustard and black pepper.
Spread over one slice of bread and add the cucumber and salad leaves.
Top with the second slice, cut in half and wrap.

name: Chicken Hummus And Pepper Wrap

ingredients.display: a sixth of a red onion (20 g), finely sliced

steps: Spread the hummus over the wrap, leaving a border.
Layer on the spinach, peppers, red onion and chicken, then squeeze over the lemon juice.
Season with black pepper, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Wrap in foil and cut in half to pack.

name: Prawn And Fennel Orzo Jar

ingredients.display: half a fennel bulb (80 g), finely sliced
a small handful (8 g) parsley, chopped

steps: Cook the orzo as the pack directs, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Mix the yoghurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, capers and parsley with black pepper.
Toss the orzo, prawns, fennel and tomatoes through the dressing.
Spoon into a jar or lidded box and keep chilled.

name: Gochujang Smoked Tofu Rice Bowl

ingredients.display: 150 g smoked tofu (most of a 200 g block), cubed
half a 250 g pouch (125 g) cooked wholegrain rice
1 head pak choi (100 g), leaves separated

steps: Heat the sesame oil in a frying pan and fry the tofu for 4 minutes until browned.
Add the sugar snaps and pak choi stalks and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the gochujang, soy sauce and 2 tbsp water, then add the pak choi leaves until wilted.
Heat the rice, tip into a bowl, spoon the tofu over and scatter with spring onion.

name: Red Lentil Pasta With Tomato And Basil

ingredients.display: half a 200 g tub (100 g) cottage cheese
a small handful (5 g) fresh basil, torn

steps: Boil the pasta for 7 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile heat the oil in the same pan and soften the garlic and cherry tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Add the passata and simmer for 3 minutes.
Return the pasta, stir through the cottage cheese off the heat, then top with basil and parmesan.

name: Chickpea Pasta With Pesto And Spinach

ingredients.display: half a 125 g ball (60 g) light mozzarella, torn

steps: Boil the pasta for 8 minutes, adding the frozen spinach for the last 3 minutes.
Drain, keeping 2 tbsp of the cooking water.
Return to the pan off the heat and stir through the pesto, garlic and reserved water.
Fold in the tomatoes and mozzarella and serve while hot.

name: Chickpea And Egg Shakshuka Pan

ingredients.display: half a 400 g tin (120 g drained) chickpeas
half a 400 g tin (200 g) chopped tomatoes
half a red pepper (80 g), sliced
half a small onion (50 g), sliced
a small handful (5 g) fresh coriander

steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and soften the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Stir in the paprika and cumin, then add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 5 minutes.
Make three wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with feta and coriander and eat from the pan.

name: Quorn And Pak Choi Noodle Stir-Fry

ingredients.display: 175 g Quorn pieces (most of a 300 g bag)
half a red pepper (80 g), sliced

steps: Boil the noodles for 4 minutes, then drain.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok and fry the Quorn with the ginger and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the pepper and pak choi and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Toss through the noodles, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce and serve hot.

name: Curried Cauliflower And Red Lentil Soup

ingredients.display: a third of a cauliflower (150 g), in florets
1 vegetable stock cube, made up with 600 ml water
a small handful (5 g) fresh coriander

steps: Fry the onion and carrot in a dry pan with the curry paste for 3 minutes, adding a splash of water.
Add the lentils, cauliflower and stock, then simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend until smooth, or leave chunky.
Stir in the yoghurt off the heat and top with coriander. Chill any extra and reheat the next day.

name: Warm Halloumi And Bulgur Bowl

ingredients.display: 80 g halloumi (a third of a block), sliced
half a red pepper (80 g), diced
a small handful (5 g) fresh parsley, chopped

steps: Cover the bulgur with boiling water and leave for 12 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes.
Fry the halloumi in the oil for 2 minutes each side until golden, adding the pepper alongside.
Drain the bulgur and edamame and stir through the lemon juice and parsley.
Top with the halloumi and pepper and spoon the yoghurt on the side.

name: Miso Chicken Egg Noodle Bowl

ingredients.display: a handful (60 g) sugar snap peas

steps: Bring 500 ml water to a simmer with the ginger and poach the chicken for 8 minutes.
Add the noodles, sugar snaps and pak choi and cook for 4 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the miso, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Pour into a bowl and top with spring onion.

name: One-Pan Turkey And Gnocchi

ingredients.display: 150 g 5% fat turkey mince (a third of a 500 g pack)
150 g fresh gnocchi (a third of a 500 g pack)

steps: Brown the turkey mince in the oil for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the garlic, oregano, passata and frozen spinach with a splash of water and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the gnocchi, cover and cook for 5 minutes until tender.
Grate the parmesan over. Cook double and reheat the second portion the next day.

name: Tinned Mackerel Jacket Potato

ingredients.display: 1 tin (120 g) mackerel fillets in tomato sauce
half a 200 g tub (100 g) cottage cheese

steps: Prick the potato and microwave for 10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Flake the mackerel with its tomato sauce and the lemon juice.
Split the potato, fill with cottage cheese and spoon the mackerel on top.
Finish with spring onion and rocket.

name: Ham And Mozzarella Muffin Melt
steps: Toast the muffin halves cut side up under a hot grill for 2 minutes.
Spread with mustard, then layer on the ham, tomato and mozzarella.
Grill for 4 minutes until the cheese is bubbling, and eat straight away.

name: Smoked Paprika Chicken Orzo

ingredients.display: half a red pepper (80 g), diced
half a small onion (50 g), chopped
half a chicken stock cube, made up with 250 ml water
a small handful (5 g) fresh parsley, chopped

steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the onion and pepper for 3 minutes.
Stir in the paprika, orzo, passata and stock.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender and the sauce thick.
Season and scatter with parsley.

name: Pollock And Sweetcorn Chowder

ingredients.display: 2 pollock fillets (180 g), cut into chunks
half a small tin (80 g) sweetcorn, drained
1 fish or vegetable stock cube, made up with 250 ml water
1 tbsp cornflour, slaked in cold water
a small handful (5 g) fresh parsley, chopped

steps: Simmer the leek and potatoes in the stock for 10 minutes.
Add the milk and sweetcorn and bring back to a gentle simmer.
Add the pollock and poach for 5 minutes until it flakes.
Stir in the slaked cornflour to thicken, then add the parsley. Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

name: Crab And Sweetcorn Egg Drop Soup

ingredients.display: 2 tins (120 g drained) white crab meat
half a small tin (80 g) sweetcorn, drained
1 chicken stock cube, made up with 500 ml water
1 tbsp cornflour, slaked in cold water

steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger and sweetcorn for 3 minutes.
Stir in the slaked cornflour and cook for 1 minute until slightly thickened.
Add the crab, then pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil, top with spring onion and serve with the bread.

name: Sriracha Turkey Rice Noodle Bowl

ingredients.display: juice of half a lime (2 tsp)
a small handful (5 g) fresh coriander

steps: Soak the rice noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Fry the turkey in the oil over a high heat for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Toss through the noodles, sriracha, fish sauce and lime juice, and top with coriander.
